name: paper-orchestra-codex
description: Evidence-first research auditing and Codex-native paper writing, with Google's separate multi-agent runner as an optional path.

interface.longDescription: Audit research evidence and draft papers with the active Codex session by default. Python supports optional local integrity checks; Google's separate API-based multi-agent pipeline is optional.
defaultPrompt: Use PaperOrchestra to audit the evidence in my research project before writing a paper.
Prepare a local evidence bundle and draft with this Codex session. Do not call external model APIs.
Draft a LaTeX manuscript from verified evidence using Codex. Mark unsupported claims and do not invent citations.
Show me how the optional Google PaperOrchestra API pipeline differs before running it.
